item.title: Sinkhole causes closures, diverts traffic in Morena area
item.description: The sinkhole was reported around 11 p.m. Wednesday at Morena Boulevard and Sherman Street, according to the San Diego Police Department.

item.title: Opinion: The San Diego Rodeo matters for Native American culture — and our city
item.description: The nationally recognized San Diego Rodeo is a clear example of how cultural celebration and economic vitality reinforce one another in our city.

item.title: More Latino students are attending Cal State — but where are the Latino professors?
item.description: Faculty representation at Cal State is lagging far behind the growing number of Latino students.

item.title: San Diego carrier USS Abraham Lincoln moving to Mideast amid Iran turmoil
item.description: The Pentagon has ordered the San Diego-based carrier USS Abraham Lincoln to move to the Middle East amid turmoil in Iran, according to media reports.

item.title: New year, new growth at San Carlos Community Garden
item.description: Located on the campus of the Sierra School of San Diego, the SCCG is a joint-use community garden created to grow far more than plants.

item.title: Kaiser Permanente to pay $556 million in record Medicare Advantage fraud settlement
item.description: The agreement is the largest Medicare Advantage fraud settlement to date.

item.title: County supervisor joins protest against ICE violence
item.description: San Diegans continued their protests against ICE violence on Thursday morning, with Dist. 1 Supervisor Paloma Aguirre joining the crowd at the federal building downtown. item.title: MTS opposes driverless car services like Waymo without local oversight
item.description: The vote by San Diego Metropolitan Transit System directors comes as Waymo cars have been spotted on local streets.

item.title: San Diego Weekend Guide: Jan. 16-18 – MLK & Motocross
item.description: San Diego County honors Rev. Dr. Martin Luther King’s legacy this weekend with activities that invite you to give back, connect with community and pull from the well of joy.

item.title: Despite jeers, Gloria sticks to the script at State of the City, spotlighting progress but not the deficit
item.description: In last year's State of the City address, a stern Mayor Todd Gloria harped on buckling down to address a lofty budget deficit. This year, he took a different approach, informing San Diego residents that "the markers of our progress are all around, and I'm here to tell you there are even more ahead."
